# ExactWiringRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property that precise synaptic connectivity determines how inputs are routed to specific downstream targets, even when gross statistics are fixed. Highlights the need for exact topology control in TCC architectures to achieve targeted signal routing, beyond just statistical connectivity.
